entries.name: Flame Trail
entries.description: Blink leaves a wall of fire along its actual path. I–III: 3/3.5/4s, 12/18/24 damage per target every 0.5s; width 10/12/14px. One specialization per run.

entries.name: Slowing Flame
entries.description: Blink leaves cold fire that slows regular enemies by 40%. I–III: 3/3.5/4s, wall width 12/18/24px. Does not stack. One specialization per run.

entries.name: Arcane Sprint
entries.description: After Blink: +30/35/40% speed for 2s. Recasting refreshes the effect. One specialization per run.

entries.name: Cleaving Dash
entries.description: Hits all targets along the actual Dash path. I–III: 36/48/60 damage, width 12/14/16px. Each target is hit once per Dash. One specialization per run.

entries.name: Absorb Shield
entries.description: After Dash: Absorb equal to 25/30/35% maxHP for 3s. The shield takes damage before HP; recasting refreshes its strength. One specialization per run.

entries.name: Berserk
entries.description: For 2s after Dash: +25/30/35% damage, 25/30/35% CDR and +30/35/40% movement speed. Affects newly started cooldowns; another dash refreshes the effect without stacking. One specialization per run.

entries.name: Ember Heat
entries.description: +25% ability damage.

entries.name: Swift Ritual
entries.description: Abilities recharge 10% faster.

entries.name: Double Spark
entries.description: +1 fireball per attack (up to 4).

entries.name: Light Step
entries.description: +13.5px/s movement speed.

entries.name: Root Strength
entries.description: +20 maximum health and heal 30 HP.

entries.name: Attraction
entries.description: +20 crystal pickup radius.

entries.name: Wide Circle
entries.description: +15% area magic radius.

entries.name: Frost Nova
entries.description: An ice ring targets a dense group within 310px and the screen. The 1.2s root does not stop ranged attacks; targets gain 2s root immunity afterward. Bosses and Guardians receive a limited slow.

entries.name: Chain Lightning
entries.description: Unlock: lightning jumps between enemies.

entries.name: Armageddon
entries.description: Automatically targets a dense group within 310px and the screen. Lands after 0.22s; ranks III/V add 2/3 strikes at 0.15s intervals.

entries.name: Arcane Shield
entries.description: Absorbs 15/20/25/30/35% maxHP for 6–10s. Excess damage reaches HP. Recasting replaces the remaining shield without stacking.

entries.name: Whirlwind
entries.description: A series of circular strikes over 1.2s.

entries.name: Ground Stomp
entries.description: A marked area strike after a 0.65s delay.

entries.name: Piercing Throw
entries.description: A spear travels up to 360px with a 28px hit width, increased by area bonuses. Pierces 3–7 targets, hitting each once.

entries.name: Shield Block
entries.description: Reduces damage by 50%, absorbs enemy projectiles and grants Absorb equal to 20–40% maxHP while blocking. Recasting refreshes the shield without stacking.

entries.name: Fireball +
entries.description: +20% base fire damage. V + Ember Heat III: an extra piercing fireball.

entries.name: Frost Nova +
entries.description: I: 1.2s root. II: +20% radius. III: −15% base cooldown. IV: 1.7s root. V: 2s root and another +20% radius. +6 damage per rank; V + Wide Circle III retains +30% damage.

entries.name: Chain Lightning +
entries.description: +9 damage and +1 chain target (up to 7 targets).

entries.name: Armageddon +
entries.description: +25 damage and +7px radius. I–V: 1/1/2/2/3 meteors. Interval 0.15s; extra strikes deal 75% damage. Equally dense groups prioritize rooted targets.

entries.name: Arcane Shield +
entries.description: Absorb I–V: 15/20/25/30/35% maxHP. +1s duration per rank. Recasting refreshes the shield without stacking.

entries.name: Cleave +
entries.description: +8 base damage to the wide strike.

entries.name: Whirlwind +
entries.description: +4 damage to each circular pulse.

entries.name: Ground Stomp +
entries.description: +15 damage and +5px strike radius.

entries.name: Piercing Throw +
entries.description: +12 spear damage and +1 pierced target (up to 7 targets).

entries.name: Shield Block +
entries.description: +5% maxHP Absorb and +0.5s Shield Block duration. Recasting refreshes the shield.

entries.name: Fireball: evolution
entries.description: The first fireball hit explodes for 45% damage within 38px.

entries.name: Frost Nova: evolution
entries.description: Two hits within 4s add 0.75s to the next eligible root, at most once every 6s. Does not extend an active root or bypass subsequent immunity.

entries.name: Chain Lightning: evolution
entries.description: Two secondary bolts hit new targets for 35% damage.

entries.name: Armageddon: evolution
entries.description: Each strike leaves fire for 3s, ticking every 0.5s. Fire from extra meteors also deals 75% damage.

entries.name: Arcane Shield: evolution
entries.description: Breaking Absorb triggers one 90px defensive pulse per shield activation.

entries.name: Sip of Life
entries.description: Restore 40 HP.

entries.name: Flash
entries.description: 120 damage to all enemies within 150px.

entries.name: Crystal Call
entries.description: Collect all crystals on the field.

mage.name: Heavenly Wrath
mage.description: A devastating discharge: an instant branching web of lightning. The first charge is ready; recharge with 10 successful Blinks.

mage.name: Absolute Zero
mage.description: A rune freezes even bosses and Guardians for 4 seconds, followed by 4 seconds of ice. An ice avalanche spreads outward after casting: 180 damage, capped at 8% HP for bosses and Guardians. The first charge is ready; recharge with 10 successful Blinks.

mage.name: Funeral Pyre
mage.description: 10 seconds of fire: burns projectiles, scorches enemies and heals 20% HP/s. Every 2 seconds the radius grows by 10% of its original size. The first charge is ready; recharge with 10 successful Blinks.

warrior.name: Vanguard Banner
warrior.description: A banner lasts 15 seconds. Restores 10% maxHP per second within 140px. The first charge is ready; recharge with 10 successful dashes.

warrior.name: Threefold Fissure
warrior.description: Three branches extend 280px forward: 4 successive waves of 100 damage. Each target is hit once per wave; total damage to bosses and Guardians is capped at 16% maxHP. The first charge is ready; recharge with 10 successful dashes.

warrior.name: Battering Spear
warrior.description: A heavy spear pierces enemies over 560px: 420 damage. At its endpoint, deals 140 damage within 48px to targets not already hit. Bosses and Guardians take at most 18% maxHP per cast. The first charge is ready; recharge with 10 successful dashes.
